imagery.home-hero: The Atlas foothills at first light, layered ridgelines fading into haze, a single road tracing the valley floor.
imagery.home-intro: Overhead view of a working table: printed audience maps, a channel plan annotated in pencil, a hand moving a card.
imagery.home-services: Interior of a creative studio at dusk: a lit edit bay on one side, a product-shoot corner on the other.
imagery.home-why: Hands pinning printed frames to a research wall already covered in storyboards, lit by a raking lamp.
imagery.home-results: A laptop on a desk showing a rising audience curve, beside an annotated printed report.
imagery.services-hero: Seven printed briefs laid out in a row on a large table, each open to a different spread, in morning light.
imagery.service-strategie-marketing: A quarterly plan drawn by hand across large wall paper, marked out with coloured tags.
imagery.service-social-media: Nine vertical-format frames arranged on a light table, being reordered by hand.
imagery.service-creation-contenu: A small shoot set being built: product on a beige riser, diffuser panel, camera on a low tripod.
imagery.service-branding: A brand system laid out flat: paper swatches, three weights of a typeface printed large, folded stationery.
imagery.service-production-audiovisuelle: A film set between takes: camera facing the lit set, a large soft source off to one side.
imagery.service-publicite-digitale: Two screens side by side showing an ad account and a performance curve, a notebook of figures in front.
imagery.service-web: The same page shown across three aligned devices — laptop, tablet, phone — beside wireframe sketches.
imagery.method-hero: A wall of six sheets pinned side by side, each denser than the last, watched from a distance by a figure.
imagery.method-discover: An interview underway at a small table: a recorder between two people, a notebook filling up.
imagery.method-strategize: A sheet carrying a positioning line written by hand, surrounded by crossed-out earlier drafts.
imagery.method-create: A grading station mid-session: a graded frame on a calibrated monitor, graphics tablet and pen in use.
imagery.method-distribute: A publishing calendar filled across a month, a phone beside it showing a post just gone live.
imagery.method-optimize: A printed performance report comparing two variants, one circled in green pencil.
imagery.method-scale: A wide window view over a Moroccan city at dusk, from a working floor with the day still open on the desk.
imagery.about-name: A lone High Atlas peak in afternoon light, snow across the upper third, ochre scree in the foreground.
imagery.about-story: A modest first workspace: two desks pushed together, a window, equipment cases stacked against the wall.
imagery.about-values: Hands squaring up a stack of printed proofs on a workbench, one sheet held to the light to check.
imagery.solutions-hero: Three folders of differing thickness lined up on a clean surface, each tabbed with a coloured marker.
imagery.solutions-pack-launch: A single sheet on a clear desk, one line written at the top, a pen resting across it.
imagery.solutions-pack-growth: A monthly wall planner two-thirds filled with coloured markers, a hand adding the next block.
imagery.solutions-pack-project: A production case open on the floor, lenses and cards set in foam, one slot empty.
imagery.contact: An editorial Middle Atlas landscape with cedar forest, layered ridges and a winding road in late-afternoon light.
imagery.blog: A closed notebook and a fountain pen on a bare table, crossed by a shaft of light.
imagery.quote: A short printed brief on a table, a pen laid diagonally across it, a phone face-down beside it.
